newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's troubled Norilsk plant gets new director.
newsitem.headline: Russia's troubled Norilsk plant gets new director.

text.p: Russia's financially troubled Norilsk Nickel NKEL.RTS metals group said on Wednesday that it had appointed Djhonson Khagazheyev director of its flagship metals plant.

A company news release said a Norilsk board meeting to assess production, the regional budget and social issues at the plant, the Norilsk mining and metallurgical complex, had recommended continuing work in these areas.
The main trade union at the complex has said it plans strikes on March 27 and April 2 over salary and other arrears.
The release did not discuss the possibility of disruptions to output or give any details on negotiations with labour leaders and regional budget authorities.
Khagazheyev was first deputy general director of RAO Norilsky Nickel 0#NKEL.RUO, the parent of the flagship plant, and acting general director of Norilsk subsidiary Severonickel.
He replaces Leonid Galperin, appointed director of the flagship plant in January after replacing Nikolai Abramov. The release did not say who was now in charge of Severonickel.

Norilsk owes its flagship plant workers around 900 billion roubles in wages unpaid over two months and about 1.2 trillion roubles to various budgets, for which it seeking debt relief from regional authorities.
